description: This Java class provides utility methods for working with generic entities, specifically to retrieve the class type of a generic entity from a class definition, leveraging reflection.

classes.name: GenericEntityUtils
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for retrieving generic entity class types using reflection.

methods.name: getGenericEntityClassFromComponentDefinition
methods.description: Returns the Class object of the generic entity type that extends SalesManagerEntity from a given class, traversing superclasses if necessary.
